scripts.validate: node -e "const fs=require('node:fs'); const { spawnSync } = require('node:child_process'); if (fs.existsSync('scripts/validate.mjs')) { const result = spawnSync(process.execPath, ['scripts/validate.mjs'], { stdio: 'inherit' }); process.exit(result.status ?? 1); } console.log('scripts/validate.mjs not present yet; skipping validation.');"
scripts.build: npm run validate && tsc -b && vite build
